name: LCNB Corp.
summary: LCNB Corp. operates as the financial holding company for LCNB National Bank that provides banking services in the United States. It offers checking and savings accounts; interest-bearing demand and money market deposit; and time certificates. The company also provides commercial and industrial, commercial and residential real estate, agricultural, construction, various types of consumer, and small business administration loans; residential mortgage loans, such as loans for purchasing or refinancing personal residences, home equity lines of credit, and loans for commercial or consumer purposes secured by residential mortgages; and consumer lending comprising automobile, boat, home improvement…
